refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to make a real-number value

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoValueCreateFromReal function creates a new value. Its status will be SilikoValueReal and its real-number value will be source.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoTokenCreateFromReal returns a pointer to the newly created SilikoToken object if successful, or NULL on failure.
